paragraphs: CSW is a diversified industrial growth company with a strategic focus on providing niche, value-added products in the end markets we serve. We operate in three business segments: Contractor Solutions, Specialized Reliability Solutions and Engineered Building Solutions. Our products include mechanical products for heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration ("HVAC/R"), plumbing products, grilles, registers and diffusers ("GRD"), building safety solutions and high-performance specialty lubricants and sealants. End markets that we serve include HVAC/R, architecturally-specified building products, plumbing, general industrial, energy, rail transportation, mining and electrical. Our manufacturing operations are concentrated in the United States ("U.S."), Vietnam and Canada, and we have distribution operations in the U.S., Australia, Canada and the United Kingdom ("U.K."). Our products are sold directly to end-users or through designated channels in over 100 countries around the world, primarily in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and Australia.

Drawing on our innovative and proven technologies, we seek to deliver solutions primarily to our contractors that place a premium on superior performance and reliability. We believe our brands are well known in the specific end markets we serve and have a reputation for high quality. We rely on both organic growth and inorganic growth through acquisitions to provide an increasingly broad portfolio of performance optimizing solutions that meet our customers' ever-changing needs. We have a successful record of making attractive and synergistic acquisitions that support expansion of our broad portfolio of solutions, and we remain focused on identifying additional acquisition opportunities in our core end markets.

Through our operating companies, we have a well-established legacy of providing high quality products accompanied by dependable service and attention to customer satisfaction. We also have a long history of innovation, through which we have developed a robust line of products to solve our customers' specific challenges. These products are distributed through an extensive wholesale distribution network serving the HVAC/R, architecturally-specified buildings products, plumbing, general industrial, energy, rail transportation, mining and electrical end markets. Our desire to develop solutions for our contractors, combined with the differentiated nature of our niche product offerings, drives loyalty to our brands.

CSW is a Delaware corporation and was incorporated in 2014 in anticipation of CSW's separation from Capital Southwest Corporation ("Capital Southwest"). Our well-established operating companies provide a collective history that spans more than a century. The separation was executed on September 30, 2015 through a pro-rata share distribution of all the then outstanding shares of common stock of CSW to the holders of common stock of Capital Southwest (the "Share Distribution"). Since the separation, CSW has been an independent, publicly-traded company, initially listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. On April 29, 2025, we announced our intention to transfer the listing of our common stock from the Nasdaq Global Select Market to the New York Stock Exchange. CSW common stock commenced trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the stock symbol "CSW" on June 9, 2025.

During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we committed to a plan to pursue a sale of the Greco US business and a strategic exit of the Greco Canada business (the "Greco Canada Exit"). As a result of these initiatives, we recorded a non-cash impairment expense of $15.6 million for the Greco US and Canada businesses, and recorded additional expenses of $2.1 million in connection with the Greco Canada Exit, both of which are reported in our Engineered Building Solutions segment.

On March 12, 2026, we acquired certain assets of Joyce Sales Group, LLC and Copper2Glass, LLC (collectively, "Duckt-Strip") for a cash consideration of $21.0 million, which was funded with borrowings under our existing Revolving Credit Facility (as defined in Note 9). Duckt-Strip offers a differentiated, code‑compliant electrical cable solution purpose‑built for ductless HVAC/R systems.

On November 20, 2025, we acquired certain assets of ProAction Fluids, LLC ("ProAction Fluids") for a cash consideration of $9.5 million, which was funded with borrowings under our existing Revolving Credit Facility. ProAction Fluids offers performance-tested drilling fluids, lubricants, sealants, and compounds for the horizontal directional drilling ("HDD") market that expand upon, and are complementary to, our existing general industrial product portfolio.

On November 5, 2025, we acquired certain assets of Hydrotex Holdings, Inc. ("Hydrotex") for an aggregate purchase price of $17.0 million. The cash consideration was funded with borrowings under our existing Revolving Credit Facility. Hydrotex offers high-performance lubricants designed to enhance operational efficiency, reduce equipment wear, and extend service life that expand upon, and are complementary to, our existing general industrial products portfolio.

On November 4, 2025, we entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit agreement (the "Fourth Credit Agreement") with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent (in such capacity, the "Administrative Agent") and collateral agent, and the lenders, issuing banks and swingline lender party thereto. The Fourth Credit Agreement, among other things, provides for: (i) the continuation of the existing Revolving Credit Facility in the aggregate principal committed amount of up to $700.0 million; (ii) the extension of the maturity date of the Revolving Credit Facility until November 4, 2030; and (iii) the establishment of a new senior secured term loan "A" credit facility (the "TLA") in an aggregate principal amount of up to $600.0 million, and having a maturity date of November 4, 2030.

On November 4, 2025, we acquired 100% of the equity interests of Dusk Acquisition Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries, Motors & Armatures, LLC and HVAC South, LLC (collectively, "MARS Parts") for an aggregate purchase price of $658.1 million. The cash consideration was funded with a combination of the TLA and borrowings under our existing Revolving Credit Facility. MARS Parts was one of the largest providers of HVAC/R parts and supplies in North America, and a leading provider of motors and capacitors. With a product mix more heavily focused on repair versus replacement, we expect MARS Parts will strategically complement our current HVAC/R end market, which traditionally has been more focused on new unit installations and replacements.

On May 2, 2025, the Company entered into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, and other lenders party thereto. The Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement renewed the Company's existing Revolving Credit Facility, which refreshed the term for five years and increased the commitment to $700.0 million. Refer to Note 9 for additional information.

On May 1, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity interests of Aspen Manufacturing, LLC ("Aspen Manufacturing") for an aggregate purchase price of $327.6 million, which was funded with cash on hand and borrowings under our existing Revolving Credit Facility. Aspen Manufacturing is one of the largest independent evaporator coil and air handler manufacturers for the HVAC/R industry and is recognized as a leader in product quality and indoor comfort. Aspen Manufacturing's current product suite includes a vast range of high-quality residential and light commercial evaporator coils, blowers, and air handling units for single-family, multi-family, and manufactured homes.

headings: Changes in global trade policy and the impact on tariffs may have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
Certain end markets that we serve are cyclical, which can cause significant fluctuations in our results of operations and cash flows.
Climate change could have an adverse effect on our business.
Climate change regulations may impact our ability to operate at a profit and harm our operating margins.
Business, Operations and Human Capital Risks

Our international sales and manufacturing operations, including our use of third-party manufacturers for certain products that we sell, involve inherent risks that could result in harm to our business.
Our insurance policies may not cover, or fully cover, us against natural disasters, global conflicts or environmental risk.

Cybersecurity breaches and other disruptions to our information technology systems could compromise our information, disrupt our operations, and expose us to liability, which may adversely impact our operations.
Artificial Intelligence Technologies Could Present Business, Compliance, and Reputational Risks.
Our relationships with our employees could deteriorate, which could adversely affect our operations.
Loss of key personnel or our inability to attract and retain new qualified personnel could hurt our business and inhibit our ability to operate and grow successfully.
Our acquisition and integration of businesses could negatively impact our financial results.
We may be unable to successfully execute and realize the expected financial benefits from strategic initiatives.
Our outstanding indebtedness and the restrictive covenants in the agreements governing our indebtedness limit our operating and financial flexibility.
Fluctuations in currency exchange rates may significantly impact our results of operations and may significantly affect the comparability of our results between financial periods.
Changes in effective tax rates or adverse outcomes resulting from examination of our income tax returns could adversely affect our results.
We may acquire various structured financial instruments for purposes of hedging or reducing our risks, which may be costly and ineffective.
We may inadvertently fail to maintain effective disclosure controls and procedures and internal controls over financial reporting.
Regulatory and statutory changes applicable to us or our customers could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
Compliance with extensive environmental, health and safety laws could require material expenditures, changes in our operations or site remediation.
Industrial manufacturing is inherently hazardous, which could result in accidents that disrupt our operations or expose us to significant losses or liabilities.
Regulation of our employees' exposure to certain chemicals or other hazardous products could require material expenditures or changes in our operations.
We may be unable to protect our trademarks, trade secrets, other intellectual property and proprietary information, which could harm our competitive position.
paragraphs: Consider carefully the following risk factors, which we believe are the principal risks that we face and of which we are currently aware, and the other information in this Annual Report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes to those financial statements. It is possible that additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us, or that we currently deem immaterial, may also impair our business operations.

We have significant manufacturing operations in Vietnam, in addition to using third parties located in China and elsewhere outside the United States to manufacture some of our products. Since February 2025, the President of the United States has issued various executive orders to regulate imports by imposing reciprocal country-specific tariffs on multiple nations around the world, including Vietnam and China (among other jurisdictions). In addition, the United States has imposed and/or reimposed certain commodity-specific tariffs, including tariffs on steel, aluminum and copper, which are used as inputs for some of our products. We have responded by negotiating cost reductions with certain suppliers, transitioning certain sources of supply, and by raising prices to our customers on certain products across our three segments to partially offset the impact. In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a decision invalidating tariffs imposed under the IEEPA, which include many of the tariffs imposed by the President of the United States since February 2025. The ruling may allow for recovery of IEEPA tariff amounts previously paid, although the timing and administration of any potential IEEPA tariff refunds is uncertain and may be subject to further legal and regulatory developments. We are assessing our potential refund rights and are pursuing a recovery of amounts paid; however this recovery will likely be subject to applicable procedures and may add complexity and uncertainty into our operations. Additionally, the current presidential administration has imposed tariffs on goods imported into the United States pursuant to legislative authorities other than IEEPA, and has indicated that it may continue to pursue these policies in the future.

Tariffs or other trade restrictions may lead to continuing uncertainty and volatility in U.S. economic conditions and commodity markets, declining consumer confidence, significant inflation and diminished expectations for the economy, and ultimately reduced demand for our products. Such conditions could have a material adverse impact on our future net sales, cost of goods sold in the United States, profit and cash flow. The current situation is dynamic, and the ultimate effect will be dependent on the magnitude and duration of the tariffs and the countries implicated, as well as our ability to mitigate their impact. The Company is evaluating the potential impacts of these tariffs, as well as assessing and implementing options to mitigate any potential impact. Changing our operations in accordance with new or changed trade restrictions can be expensive, time-consuming, disruptive to our operations and distracting to management. Such restrictions have been, and in the future may be, announced, amended, paused, reinstated or rescinded with little or no advance notice, and we may not be able to mitigate all adverse impacts from such measures, effectively.

The industries in which we operate are highly competitive, and many of our products are in highly competitive markets. We may lose market share to producers of other products that directly compete with or that can be substituted for our products.

The industries in which we operate are highly competitive, and we face significant competition from both large domestic and international competitors and from smaller regional competitors. Our competitors may improve their competitive position in our served markets by successfully introducing new or substitute products, improving their manufacturing processes or expanding their capacity or manufacturing facilities. Further, some of our competitors benefit from advantageous cost positions that could make it increasingly difficult for us to compete in markets for less-differentiated applications. If we are unable to keep pace with our competitors' products and manufacturing process innovations or cost position, our financial condition and results of operations could be materially adversely affected.

The cyclical nature of the supply and demand balance of certain end markets that we serve, including HVAC/R, general industrial, construction, energy, rail transportation and mining, poses risks to us that are beyond our control and can affect our operating results. These markets are highly competitive; are driven to a large extent by end-use markets; are affected by distributor stocking behaviors; and may experience overcapacity, all of which may affect demand for and pricing of our products and result in volatile operating results and cash flows over our business cycle. Our operations and earnings may also be affected by changes in oil, gas and petrochemical prices and drilling activities, which depend on local, regional and global events or conditions that affect supply and demand for the relevant commodity. Product demand may not be sufficient to utilize current or future capacity. Excess industry capacity may depress our volumes and margins on some products. Our operating results, accordingly, may be volatile as a result of excess industry capacity, as well as from rising energy and raw materials costs.

The ongoing conflict in the Middle East, including active military operations in Iran beginning February 28, 2026, has contributed to disruptions in global shipping lanes, particularly through the Strait of Hormuz and the broader Persian Gulf region. While we do not source materials directly from Iran or the Persian Gulf region, the conflict has contributed to elevated crude oil prices, ocean and domestic freight and certain commodity costs and extended lead times from Asian suppliers as

carriers reroute through alternative passages including the Cape of Good Hope. We are working with our logistics partners to mitigate these impacts and do not currently believe they will have a material adverse effect on our ability to meet customer demand, though we continue to monitor the situation closely.

CSW 是一家多元化工業成長公司，以提供我們服務的終端市場中具專業性且具附加價值的產品為戰略重點。我們經營三個業務分部：承包商解決方案、專業可靠性解決方案與工程建築解決方案。我們的產品包括用於供暖、通風、空調與冷氣（"HVAC/R"）的機械產品、水管產品、風閥、風口與散流器（"GRD"）、建築安全解決方案以及高性能專業潤滑油與密封劑。我們服務的終端市場包括 HVAC/R、建築指定產品、水管、一般工業、能源、鐵路運輸、採礦與電氣。我們的製造業務集中於美國（"U.S."）、越南與加拿大，我們在美國、澳洲、加拿大與英國（"U.K."）設有銷售業務。我們的產品直接銷售給終端用戶或透過指定通路在全球超過 100 個國家銷售，主要在美國、加拿大、英國與澳洲。

我們透過創新且經過驗證的技術，主要為我們的承包商提供解決方案，這些承包商重視卓越的性能與可靠性。我們相信我們的品牌在服務的特定終端市場中具有良好聲譽，並以高品質聞名。我們依賴內生成長與外生成長（透過收購）來提供越來越廣泛的性能優化解決方案，以符合客戶不斷變化的需求。我們有成功的收購紀錄，這些收購具有吸引力且具有協同效益，支持我們廣泛解決方案組合的擴張，我們持續專注於在核心終端市場尋找額外的收購機會。
透過我們的營運公司，我們有著長期的歷史，提供高品質的產品並伴隨可靠的服務與關注客戶滿意度。我們也擁有長久的創新歷史，透過此我們已開發出一整套強大的產品線，以解決客戶的特定挑戰。這些產品透過廣泛的經銷網路銷售，服務 HVAC/R、建築指定產品、水管、一般工業、能源、鐵路運輸、採礦與電氣終端市場。我們希望為承包商開發解決方案，加上我們專業產品組合的差異化特性，推動客戶對我們品牌的忠誠度。

CSW 是一家德拉瓦州公司，於 2014 年成立，預期 CSW 從 Capital Southwest Corporation（"Capital Southwest"）分拆。我們長期的營運公司提供超過一個世紀的歷史。分拆於 2015 年 9 月 30 日透過將當時所有 CSW 普通股股份按比例分發給 Capital Southwest 普通股股東（"股份分發"）執行。自分拆以來，CSW 成為一家獨立的上市公司，最初在納斯達克全球選選市場上市。2025 年 4 月 29 日，我們宣佈有意將我們普通股的上市地點從納斯達克全球選選市場轉移到紐約證券交易所。CSW 普通股於 2025 年 6 月 9 日在紐約證券交易所開始交易，股票代碼為 "CSW"。
在財務 2026 年第四季，我們承諾執行一個計畫，以出售 Greco US 事業並戰略退出 Greco Canada 事業（"Greco Canada 退出"）。由於這些計畫，我們記錄了 Greco US 與 Canada 事業的非現金減值費用為 1,560 萬美元，並記錄了與 Greco Canada 退出相關的額外費用為 210 萬美元，這些費用均計入我們的工程建築解決方案分部。
2026 年 3 月 12 日，我們以現金 2,100 萬美元收購 Joyce Sales Group, LLC 與 Copper2Glass, LLC（合稱 "Duckt-Strip"）的資產，此筆資金來自我們現有循環信貸融資（如第 9 註釋所定義）。Duckt-Strip 提供一種差異化、符合規範的電氣電纜解決方案，專為無風管 HVAC/R 系統設計。
2025 年 11 月 20 日，我們以現金 950 萬美元收購 ProAction Fluids, LLC（"ProAction Fluids"）的資產，此筆資金來自我們現有循環信貸融資。ProAction Fluids 提供經過性能測試的鑽探液、潤滑油、密封劑與化合物，服務於水平定向鑽探（"HDD"）市場，並擴展並補充我們現有的一般工業產品組合。
2025 年 11 月 5 日，我們以總計 1,700 萬美元收購 Hydrotex Holdings, Inc.（"Hydrotex"）的資產，此筆現金資金來自我們現有循環信貸融資。Hydrotex 提供高性能潤滑油，用以提升運作效率、減少設備磨損並延長使用壽命，並擴展並補充我們現有的一般工業產品組合。

於 2025 年 11 月 4 日，本公司與 JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 籤訂第四次修正並重述信貸協議（"第四信貸協議"），JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 為行政代理（在該職務下稱為 "行政代理"）及擔保代理，並與貸款人、發行銀行及 swingline 貸款人。第四信貸協議，除其他事項外，包含：(i) 繼續現有循環信貸融資，總承諾本金金額最高為 7 億美元；(ii) 將循環信貸融資的到期日延長至 2030 年 11 月 4 日；以及 (iii) 建立新的高階擔保過渡貸款 "A" 信貸融資（"TLA"），總本金金額最高為 6 億美元，並於 2030 年 11 月 4 日到期。

於 2025 年 11 月 4 日，本公司取得 Dusk Acquisition Corporation 及其全資子公司 Motors & Armatures, LLC 與 HVAC South, LLC（合稱 "MARS 零組件"）100% 的股權，總購買價格為 6.581 億美元。現金對價由 TLA 與現有循環信貸融資借款組合提供資金。MARS 零組件為北美最大的 HVAC/R 零組件與供應商之一，並為馬達與電容器的主要供應商。由於產品組成較重視維修而非更換，本公司預期 MARS 零組件將戰略性地補足本公司目前的 HVAC/R 終端市場，該市場傳統上較重視新機器安裝與更換。
於 2025 年 5 月 2 日，本公司與 JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 籤訂第三次修正並重述信貸協議，JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 為行政代理，並與其他貸款人。第三次修正並重述信貸協議重組本公司現有循環信貸融資，將期限延長為五年，並將承諾金額提高至 7 億美元。有關更多資訊，請參閱附註 9。

於 2025 年 5 月 1 日，本公司完成取得 Aspen Manufacturing, LLC（"Aspen 製造"）100% 的股權，總購買價格為 3.276 億美元，該對價由現金及現有循環信貸融資借款提供資金。Aspen 製造為 HVAC/R 行業最大的獨立蒸發器線圈與空氣處理機器製造商之一，並被認可為產品品質與室內舒適度的領導者。Aspen 製造目前的產品組合包含大量高品質的住宅與輕型商業蒸發器線圈、風扇與空氣處理單元，適用於單戶住宅、多戶住宅與預製房屋。
本公司業務分為三個應報告分部：承包商解決方案、專業可靠性解決方案與工程建築解決方案。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析旨在提高對財務報表及其附註之理解，應與其一併閱讀。請參閱本年度報告之「項目 1A. 風險因素」及「前瞻性陳述」，以瞭解與這些陳述相關之風險、不確定性及假設。除非另有說明， herein 所討論之金額皆為合併後之金額。

本公司為一多元化工業成長公司，戰略重點為在所服務之終端市場提供專業、高附加價值之產品。本公司經營三個業務分部：承包商解決方案、專業可靠性解決方案及工程建築解決方案。本公司產品包括用於加熱、通風、空調及冷氣（"HVAC/R"）之機械產品、水管產品、風閥、風口及散流器（"GRD"）、建築安全解決方案及高性能專業潤滑油與密封劑。本公司服務之終端市場包括 HVAC/R、建築指定產品、水管、一般工業、能源、採礦、電氣及鐵路運輸。本公司之製造業務主要集中於美國（"U.S."）、越南及加拿大，並在美國、澳洲、加拿大及英國（"U.K."）設有銷售與分銷業務。本公司產品直接銷售給終端用戶或透過指定通路銷售至全球超過 100 個國家，主要包括美國、加拿大、英國及澳洲。
我們運用創新且經過驗證之技術，主要為承包商提供解決方案，這些承包商重視卓越之性能與可靠性。我們相信本公司品牌在所服務之特定終端市場中具有良好聲譽，並以高品質聞名。我們依賴內生成長與外生成長（透過收購）來提供日益廣泛之性能最佳化解決方案，以符合客戶不斷變化的需求。我們有成功進行具吸引力且具有協同效應之收購之紀錄，並持續專注於在核心終端市場尋找更多收購機會。

許多本公司產品用於保護客戶之資產，這些資產價格昂貴且難以維修或更換，且對其營運至關重要。我們從許多產品之維護、維修與保養及消耗性特質中獲得一項穩定之收入來源。我們亦提供部分客製化工程產品，以強化並提升與客戶之關係。本公司產品組合之聲譽建立於超過 100 個受尊敬之品牌名稱，例如 AC Guard®、Air Sentry®、Aspen ManufacturingTM、Balco®、Cover Guard®、Deacon®、Duckt-Strip®、Dust Free®、Falcon Stainless®、Greco®、Hydrotex®、Jet-Lube®、Kopr-Kote®、Leak Freeze®、MARS®、Metacaulk®、No. 5®、OilSafe®、PF WaterWorksTM、ProAction Fluids®、PSP ProductsTM、RectorSeal®、Safe-T-Switch®、Shoemaker Manufacturing®、Smoke Guard®、TRUaire®、Turbo 200® 及 Whitmore®。

自2025年2月起，美國總統已發佈多項行政命令，以規範進口，對多個國家課徵國家特定關稅，包括越南與中國，這些國家與我們的業務相關，因我們在越南設有製造據點，並在中國及其他國家使用第三方製造。此外，美國已課徵或重新課徵某些商品特定關稅，包括鋼鐵、鋁與銅的關稅，這些商品為我們部分產品的原料。我們已透過與部分供應商協商降低成本、轉移部分供應來源，並對我們三個應報告分部的部分產品提高對客戶的價格，以部分抵消影響。2026年2月，美國最高法院作出判決，廢止根據國際緊急經濟權力法案（"IEEPA"）課徵的關稅。此判決可能允許回收先前已支付的IEEPA關稅金額，不過任何潛在IEEPA關稅退款的時間與執行方式尚不確定，且可能受到進一步法律與監管發展的影響。我們正在評估我們的潛在退款權利，並追討已支付的金額；然而此退款將很可能受到適用程序的限制，並可能增加我們營運的複雜性與不確定性。此外，現任總統行政團隊已根據除IEEPA以外的立法權限，對進口至美國的商品課徵關稅，並表示可能未來持續推行此政策。目前情況動態變化，最終影響將取決於關稅的規模與持續時間、涉及的國家，以及我們緩衝影響的能力，我們持續積極評估與執行緩衝方案。

中東地區的持續衝突，包括自2026年2月28日起在伊朗進行的軍事行動，已導致全球航運通道的中斷，特別是在霍爾木茲海峽與更廣泛的波斯灣地區。雖然我們並未直接從伊朗或波斯灣地區進口原料，但此衝突已導致原油價格上漲、海洋與國內運輸費與某些商品成本上升，以及來自亞洲供應商的交貨時間延長，因運輸業者改經由替代航線，包括好望角。我們正在與物流夥伴合作以緩解這些影響，目前我們不認為這些影響會對我們履行客戶需求的能力造成重大不利影響，不過我們持續密切監測此情況。
在財務年度2026年第四季，我們承諾執行一個計畫，以出售Greco US業務，並進行Greco Canada業務的戰略退出（"Greco Canada Exit"）。由於這些計畫，我們針對Greco US與加拿大業務記錄了一筆非現金減值費用，金額為1,560萬美元，並針對Greco Canada Exit記錄了額外費用210萬美元，這些費用均計入我們的工程建築解決方案應報告分部。
在財務年度2026年第四季，我們承諾執行一個計畫，以出售Greco US業務，並進行Gre這Greco Canada業務的戰略退出（"Greco Canada Exit"）。由於這些計畫，我們針對Greco US與加拿大業務記錄了一筆非現金減值費用，金額為1,560萬美元，並針對Greco Canada Exit記錄了額外費用210萬美元，這些費用均計入我們的工程建築解決方案應報告分部。
於 2026 年 3 月 12 日，本公司取得 Joyce Sales Group, LLC 與 Copper2Glass, LLC（合稱 "Duckt-Strip"）之部分資產，以現金 2,100 萬美元取得，該筆資金係透過本公司現有循環信用貸款融資（如 Note 9 所定義）。Duckt-Strip 提供一種具差異化且符合程式碼規範的電氣電纜解決方案，專為無風管 HVAC/R 系統設計。
於 2025 年 11 月 20 日，本公司取得 ProAction Fluids, LLC（"ProAction Fluids"）之部分資產，交易金額為 9.5 百萬美元，資金來自本公司現有循環信用貸款設施之借款。ProAction Fluids 提供經性能測試之鑽井液、潤滑劑、密封劑及化合物，用於水平定向鑽井（"HDD"）市場，其產品可擴展並與本公司現有一般工業產品組合相輔相成。
於 2025 年 11 月 5 日，本公司取得 Hydrotex Holdings, Inc.（"Hydrotex"）之部分資產，總計購價為 1,700 萬美元。現金部分係透過本公司現有循環信用貸款融資。Hydrotex 提供高性能潤滑劑，用以提升作業效率、減少設備磨損並延長使用壽命，並擴展及補充本公司現有一般工業產品組合。

於 2025 年 11 月 4 日，本公司與 JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 籤訂第四次修正並重述信用協議（"第四信用協議"），JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 當事人為行政代理（"行政代理"）及擔保代理，並與貸款人、發票銀行及 swingline 貸款人。第四信用協議，除其他事項外，包含：(i) 繼續現有循環信用貸款融資，總承諾本金金額最高為 7 億美元；(ii) 將循環信用貸款融資之到期日延長至 2030 年 11 月 4 日；以及 (iii) 建立新的高階擔保過橋貸款 "A" 融資（"TLA"），總承諾本金金額最高為 6 億美元，且到期日為 2030 年 11 月 4 日。

於 2025 年 11 月 4 日，本公司取得 Dusk Acquisition Corporation 全部股東權益及其全資子公司 Motors & Armatures, LLC 與 HVAC South, LLC（合稱 "MARS Parts"）之部分資產，總計購價為 6.581 億美元。現金部分係透過 TLA（如 Note 9 所定義）與本公司現有循環信用貸款融資之組合資金。MARS Parts 為北美最大的 HVAC/R 零組件與備用品供應商之一，並為馬達與電容器之領導供應商。由於其產品組合較重視維修而非更換，本公司預期 MARS Parts 將戰略性地補充本公司現有 HVAC/R 終端市場，該市場傳統上較重視新機組安裝與更換。
於 2025 年 5 月 2 日，本公司與 JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 籤訂第三次修正並重述信用協議，JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. 當事人為行政代理，並與其他貸款人。第三次修正並重述信用協議重組本公司現有循環信用貸款融資，將貸款期限延長為五年，並將承諾金額提高至 7 億美元。有關更多資訊，請參閱 Note 9。

headings: 市場、經濟與地緣政治風險
全球貿易政策的變更及關稅影響，可能對我們的業務及營運結果產生重大不利影響。
我們服務的某些終端市場具有週期性，這可能導致我們的營運結果與現金流出現顯著波動。
氣候變遷可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
氣候變遷相關法規可能影響我們以獲利方式營運的能力，並損害我們的營運毛利。
業務、營運與人力資本風險
我們的國際銷售與製造業務，包括使用第三方製造商製造部分產品，涉及內在風險，可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們的保險政策可能無法完全覆蓋或覆蓋我們因自然災害、全球衝突或環境風險所造成的損失。
資訊科技系統遭駭客入侵或其他中斷事件，可能影響我們的資訊，幹擾我們的營運，並使我們面臨法律責任，這可能會對我們的營運造成不利影響。
人工智慧技術可能帶來商業、合規及聲譽風險。
我們與員工的關係可能惡化，這可能會對我們的營運造成不利影響。
失去關鍵員工或無法吸引及留住合格的新進人才，可能影響我們的業務，並抑制我們成功營運與成長的能力。
我們收購及整合企業的行為可能對我們的財務結果造成負面影響。
我們可能無法成功執行並實現戰略計畫所預期的財務效益。
本公司未償還的債務及債務契約中所規定的限制性約束條款，會限制本公司的營運與財務彈性。
貨幣兌換率的波動可能顯著影響本公司的營運結果，也可能顯著影響本公司各會計期間的結果可比性。
有效稅率的變動或因審查本公司所得稅申報資料而產生的不利結果，可能對本公司結果造成不利影響。
本公司可能為對沖或降低風險而取得各種結構性金融工具，這些工具可能成本高昂且效果不佳。
本公司可能未有意識地維持有效的揭露控制及程序，以及財務報告的內部控制。
適用於本公司或客戶的法規與法定變動，可能對本公司財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
遵守廣泛的環境、健康與安全法規，可能需要進行重大支出、營運方式變更或場地整治。
工業製造 inherently 危險，可能會導致事故，幹擾我們的營運或使我們面臨重大損失或責任。
對我們員工接觸特定化學品或其他危險產品的規範，可能會要求我們進行重大支出或改變營運方式。
我們可能無法保護我們的商標、專利技術、其他智慧財產權及專屬資訊，這可能會損害我們的競爭地位。
paragraphs: 請謹慎考量下列風險因素，我們認為這些是我們面臨的主要風險，且目前為我們所知悉，以及本年度報告中的其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註。有可能存在其他尚未為我們所知悉，或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，也可能影響我們的業務運作。

我們在越南有相當規模的製造業務，同時也透過位於中國及其他美國以外國家的第三方製造部分產品。自2025年2月起，美國總統已發佈多項行政命令，以規範進口並對多個國家（包括越南與中國在內）課徵針對特定國家的報復性關稅。此外，美國已課徵或重新課徵某些特定商品的關稅，包括鋼鐵、鋁與銅等，這些商品為我們部分產品的原料。我們已透過與部分供應商協商降低成本、轉移部分供應來源，並提高部分產品的價格，以部分抵消這些影響。2026年2月，美國最高法院作出裁決，廢除了根據IEEPA所課徵的關稅，其中包括自2025年2月起美國總統所課徵的許多關稅。此裁決可能允許回收已支付的IEEPA關稅金額，但任何潛在IEEPA關稅退款的時間與執行方式尚不確定，且可能受到進一步法律與監管發展的影響。我們正在評估潛在退款權利，並追討已支付的金額；然而，此回收程序將受到適用程序的限制，並可能增加我們業務運作的複雜性與不確定性。此外，目前的總統政府已根據非IEEPA的立法權限對進口美國的商品課徵關稅，並表示未來可能持續推行此類政策。

關稅或其他貿易限制可能導致美國經濟狀況與商品市場持續出現不確定性與波動，消費者信心下降、顯著通貨膨脹與對經濟前景的期待降低，最終導致我們產品的需求減少。這些情況可能對我們未來的淨銷售額、美國的產品成本、利潤與現金流產生重大不利影響。目前的情況具有動態性，最終影響將取決於關稅的規模與持續時間，以及涉及的國家，以及我們緩衝這些影響的能力。本公司正在評估這些關稅的潛在影響，並評估與實施緩衝潛在影響的選項。根據新的或變更的貿易限制調整我們的業務可能成本高昂、耗時、幹擾我們的業務運作，並分散管理層的注意力。這些限制措施可能在幾乎沒有預告的情況下被宣佈、修改、暫停、恢復或廢止，我們可能無法完全緩衝這些措施的負面影響。
我們所從事的產業具有高度競爭性，且我們許多產品所處的市場也屬於高度競爭。我們可能因其他產品的生產者直接競爭或可替代我們產品而失去市場佔有率。

我們所從事的產業具有高度競爭性，我們面臨來自大型國內與國際競爭對手，以及較小區域性競爭對手的顯著競爭壓力。我們的競爭對手可能透過成功推出新產品或替代產品、改善其製造流程或擴充其生產能力或製造設施，來提升其在我們所服務市場的競爭地位。此外，部分競爭對手擁有優勢成本結構，這可能使我們在非差異化應用市場中更難以競爭。如果我們無法跟上競爭對手產品與製造流程創新或成本結構，我們的財務狀況與營運結果可能受到重大不利影響。

我們所服務的某些終端市場的供應與需求平衡具有週期性，包括空調與冷氣（HVAC/R）、一般工業、建設、能源、鐵路運輸與採礦等市場，這對我們而言是超出我們控制範疇的風險，可能影響我們的營運結果。這些市場高度競爭；主要受終端使用市場驅動；受經銷商庫存行為影響；並可能出現過度供應，所有這些因素都可能影響我們產品的需求與價格，導致我們營運結果與現金流在業務週期中出現波動。我們的營運與獲利也可能受到石油、天然氣與石化產品價格及鑽探活動的影響，而這些價格與活動取決於當地、區域與全球的事件或條件，這些條件影響相關商品的供應與需求。產品需求可能不足以利用現有或未來的生產能力。產業過度供應可能壓低某些產品的銷售量與利潤率。因此，我們的營運結果可能因產業過度供應，以及能源與原材料成本上升而出現波動。
